text:
emma_finance: Heads-up: Invoice 67921 (AcmeHealth private) landed with an odd combination of charges/credits. They flagged it.

raj_sales: Customer name only?

emma_finance: AcmeHealth. Invoice shows an overage line of $7,200 and a credit labelled PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ for $6,000. Net they owe +$1,200 beyond the expected renewal. Procurement asked for justification.

marta_revops: I pulled the billing detail and run a quick events check. Invoice excerpt:
```
Invoice 67921
- Private license (annual): $120,000
- Platform fee (annual): $30,000
- Support (std->prem prorated): $4,500
- Usage overage (migration burst): $7,200
- Credit: PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ: -$6,000
Balance: $155,700
```

lex_billing: There's no credit memo in NetSuite for that PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ code. Did sales approve something ad-hoc?

raj_sales: We approved a migration concession in Sales thread (internal), told ops to grant a courtesy credit for part of the burst. I thought billing would post a proper memo.

ops-bot: System: Dedicated pool scaling event 2025-10-03T02:15Z. Peak 118% for 3h15m. job-id: import-acme-20251003.

support_agent: Customer reported on 2025-10-04: "We were billed for spike tied to Redwood onboarding script. Please explain." They want either full reversal or detailed justification.

marta_revops: My default recommendation: treat it as onboarding migration-induced and credit the overage fully, then keep platform fee intact. That would add an extra credit of $7,200. But that might set a customer expectations precedent.

emma_finance: Full credit is risky. Propose a partial concession: 70% credit of the overage ($5,040). Sales should secure a signed PO amendment acknowledging partial responsibility. Finance needs that doc before issuing credit memo.

raj_sales: I can request the PO addendum stating the import was part of onboarding and both parties accept split responsibility. ETA 48h. If signed, sales agrees to 70% credit.

lex_billing: Once we have signed amendment and support logs attached, billing will post a credit memo for $5,040. Need GL and reason text. Suggested: GL 4202, reason "Onboarding migration overage concession, 70% approved".

marta_revops: Agreed GL 4202. I'll attach ops-bot event, support chat, and the import job logs to the ticket. Also will include the internal approval email thread id.

emma_finance: Approve issuing $5,040 credit memo after sales provides signed PO addendum and RevOps attaches the logs. Lex, hold queue until those artifacts are present.

lex_billing: Confirmed. Will not post until docs are in Zendesk ticket FIN-2482. Once present, I'll create credit memo and link to invoice 67921.

support_agent: I'll update the Zendesk thread and include customer copy of the import logs so they see transparency.

emma_finance: One more ask: include a short note on the credit memo: "Approved migration concession; customer accepted PO addendum." This helps AR for audit.

raj_sales: Noted. Pinged Acme procurement. Will update here when signed.

lex_billing: Tentative action plan summarized: (1) Wait for signed PO addendum; (2) RevOps attach ops/support logs to FIN-2482; (3) Finance issues credit memo $5,040 (GL 4202) with note; (4) Post to NetSuite against invoice 67921.

emma_finance: Agreed. Marking thread resolved pending artifacts. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
